Grid 2 is half-unit, 4 is quarter-unit and 10 is tenth-unit. Extra shares exclude hits on the corresponding scale's integer grid, and use the same eligible denominator. The shifted date controls accidental fit. Paired differences condition both comparisons on the same-day off-unit subset. Equal-date paired differences use dates with at least 100 off-unit payments. Phase controls shift by .05 and then remove either the .05 or the .95 slot, so each has nine candidate points per unit, as does the off-integer tenth grid.
